help: Grants the given amount of Exiled Sector XP to every ship in the player's fleet. Defaults to 1000 if no amount is given.
Grants the given amount of Exiled Sector XP to one ship in the player's fleet, found by its name (or part of it). Defaults to 1000 if no amount is given.
Adds copies of every socketable type to the player's cargo, each with a random roll. Defaults to 5 copies of each if no number is given, and at most 200 can be granted at once.
Adds one copy of every unique socketable to the player's cargo, each with a random roll.
Adds randomly rolled hull frameworks for every hull size to the player's cargo. Defaults to 3 of each size if no number is given, and at most 50 of each can be granted at once.
